title: Javier Vega, Jr. Memorial Act of 2017
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the Senate passed version is repeated here.)

Javier Vega, Jr. Memorial Act of 2017

(Sec. 3) This bill designates the checkpoint of the U.S. Border Patrol located on U.S. Highway 77 North in Sarita, Texas, as the "Javier Vega, Jr. Border Patrol Checkpoint."

summary.headline: A 2017 law renames a Border Patrol checkpoint in Sarita, Texas, after Javier Vega, Jr.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a new name to a U.S. Border Patrol checkpoint on U.S. Highway 77 North in Sarita, Texas. The new name is the Javier Vega, Jr. Border Patrol Checkpoint. It honors Javier Vega, Jr., and does not change how the checkpoint operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on November 2, 2017.
